hypothesis: Dense full outcome experts transferred positively with a newly trained selector but narrowly missed the source threshold. The independently frozen row-local selector was selected only by pitch-group log-loss before any dense-expert control metric and may provide better mixture weights for those same immutable experts.

frozen_inputs.experts: V5_DENSE_PITCHTYPE_MOE_V1 source artifacts; no expert retraining or refit

selector.catboost: 400 trees, depth 6, learning_rate 0.06, l2 20; BASE_FEATURES plus frozen row-local state features

candidate.blend_formula: F rows remain exact parent; on R, parent + gamma * (locked-selector dense-MoE - parent)
candidate.selection: maximize minimum full gain across 2020/2021, then minimum R gain, then smaller gamma

source_gate.on_pass: Freeze gamma and recipe before 2022/2023; do not open 2024 until both development folds and both honest anchors pass.
